episodes.title: Arrivals
episodes.summary: Desperate to reach Inuvik after her flight is canceled, New York lawyer Liv Rivera hitches a ride on a small private plane. Then, disaster strikes.

episodes.title: Fire & Water
episodes.summary: With the plane lying beneath the frigid water, Liv attempts to retrieve valuable supplies at the bottom of the lake as past demons come to the surface.

episodes.title: Hierarchy of Needs
episodes.summary: In the wilderness, Liv scrambles to secure food, fire, water and shelter. Flashbacks reveal Liv's painful past and the reason for her journey.

episodes.title: Departures
episodes.summary: Childhood memories help — and hinder — a resourceful Liv as she hikes through the woods in search of the light she saw the night before.

episodes.title: Awake & Dreaming
episodes.summary: Slipping in and out of consciousness, a trapped Liv must decide whether to continue fighting for survival — or just let go.

episodes.title: You Are Home
episodes.summary: After a giant leap, Liv faces a series of daunting challenges but finds hope and clarity when visions of her loved ones appear.
